title: Ethics Sheet for Automatic Emotion Recognition and Sentiment Analysis
findings: The paper highlights that Automatic Emotion Recognition (AER) and abusive language detection systems can learn spurious correlations from data collection methods. This can result in systems incorrectly flagging comments containing religious identity terms, such as 'Muslim' and 'Jew', as offensive. Religion is also identified as a protected category against which automatic systems can systematically discriminate.
